subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should OpenClaw core add action-claim verification or fail-closed semantics for Telegram/ACP turns beyond the current message_tool_only delivery contract and private-final warning?
rationale: The safe repair crosses privacy, delivery, and plugin-vs-core policy; automation cannot choose whether broad success-claim verification belongs in core after #68051 was closed as ClawHub/plugin scope.

options.title: Define A Narrow Core Policy
options.body: Specify which source-channel success claims require runtime proof, how missing proof is surfaced, and how private finals stay private before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep Core To Diagnostics
options.body: Retain current delivery behavior and add only operator-visible instrumentation or warnings for live Telegram/ACP repros.

options.title: Route Broad Verification To Plugins
options.body: Close or narrow this issue if maintainers decide action-claim verification should remain ClawHub/community plugin work unless plugin APIs are missing.

recommendation.title: Define A Narrow Core Policy
recommendation.body: Specify which source-channel success claims require runtime proof, how missing proof is surfaced, and how private finals stay private before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision most directly follows the prior ClawHub scope decision for #68051 and affects delivery privacy/product policy across channels.
